props.name: ColumnLayoutProps
rows: Specifies the number of columns in each grid row. When `minColumnWidth` is not set, only up to 4 columns are supported.
Specifies the content type. This determines the spacing of the grid.
Controls whether dividers are placed between rows and columns. Note: This is not supported when used with `minColumnWidth`.
Determines whether the default gutters between columns are removed.

Use together with `columns` to specify the desired minimum width for each column in pixels. The number of columns is determined by the value of this property, the available space, and the maximum number of columns as defined by the `columns` property.
